title: BJP protest condemning anti-people policies of state government

ai.summary: BJP workers protested against Congress-led state government policies on inflation, crop loss compensation, and Asha workers' pay in Mandya.

facts.claim: BJP workers protest in Mandya on Monday, submitting a memorandum to the DC over inflation, crop loss compensation and Asha workers' pay
facts.quote: BJP workers protest in Mandya on Monday, submitting a memorandum to the DC over inflation, crop loss compensation and Asha workers' pay.
